method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (the text's no where it says no; NOTHING-kind where it does not answer); the dates in one module, the employee's questions in a second, cases in a third; three regulative rules (DEONTIC functions: the s 6 (2) 60 days' notice of leave, the s 11A (4) 90-day payment of the leave credit, the s 13E 28-day notice to comply) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Long Service Leave Act 1976 (ACT), A1976-27, Republication No 29 (R29), effective 19 November 2025, last amended by A2025-30, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1976-27.txt. No instrument sets the Act's numbers.

seat: the employee: a person employed in the ACT who claims long service leave, pay for it, pay instead of it when employment ends, or pro rata pay; after the employee's death, the legal personal representative who claims the payment (lsl-employee.l4)
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: coverage, continuity of service, entitlement and amount, taking and paying for leave, payment instead of leave and pro rata payment when employment ends, records, complaints and notices to comply, awards and agreements

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lsl-dates.l4 ; l4 run lsl-employee.l4 ; l4 run lsl-employee-cases.l4
checks.result: 125 assertions written, 125 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: ss 2C, 2D, 2E, 2EA, 2F, 2G, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 10A, 11, 11A, 11C, 11D, 12 (2), 13D (4), 13E, 14; dictionary: employee, continuous service, ordinary remuneration, salary or wages. Out: ss 1-2B (formal); s 12 (1), (3); ss 12A-13CE, 13D (1)-(3), (5), 13F, 13G, 13J, 13K (officials and machinery); s 18. Reasons in NOTES.md.
